name: damage_cower_one_hit
about: Positive 18 packet admitted by 0x1032ef60: ONE_HIT_KILL independently kills below cap at 0x102beea4. Knockout writer 0x102a3339/0x102a3344, cower flag writer 0x102a585d..0x102a5874 (0x105e5788/0x105e5590/0x105e5398); no claim about the historical fifth hit.
notes: S13 acceptance prediction; measured result is recorded at V4c integration close. Current cap, wounds and flag probes are measurements; five separately logged packets in control must total 90. No arithmetic fix or retrospective knockout attribution. Second-pass measurement setup recomputes the sheet before the initial probe: base cap 100000 yields effective cap 99999, the same value read at 0x1032ef60. No damage arithmetic changed. The fixture packet carries the real player handle into 0x10265ed0; the zero packet reaches the same admission body, rather than the scalar input refusing it. TASK_SET_NPC_FLAG 0x102a585d consumes the float bit pattern: trace data 2 is 0x40000000, not numeric 1073741824. Measured zero during cower raises LIGHT_DAMAGE through 0x10265ed0, interrupts 0x109 and clears its flag before the positive packet. Restage zero before cower admission; the positive packet still follows the flag by 0.5 seconds. The positive packet is staged at flag+0.45: flag+0.5 plus frame delivery could exceed the unchanged within0.5 expectation by one tick.
